Run notes (from listing / README):
  - code_segment = $0400 — set PC to $0400 (do not follow ROM reset vector;
    $FFFC points at res_trap)
  - success trap: jmp * at $3469 (bytes 4C 69 34)
  - failure: any other self jmp * trap; test_case at $0200 holds section #
  - Soft harness only — Soft≠Physical; no Digilent flash
